name: The Arisen's Shadow: When you catch the impostor, what do you do?
prompt: When you catch the impostor, what do you do?

options.label: Refuse compensation
options.result: Brant attacks. Bermudo killed.

options.label: Demand compensation
options.result: Bermudo escapes. keeps him alive, some later Brant quests use him. 5,000 gold.

name: A Beggar's Tale: Who do you give the beggar's garb to?
prompt: Who do you give the beggar's garb to?

options.label: Give garb to Hilda
options.result: Albert returns to work. Onyx reward.

options.label: Give garb to Celina
options.result: Albert exposed as a disguised noble. Albert and Celina die after a few days. gold + Noonbloom.

name: The Ornate Box: What do you hand Sven?

options.label: Give Sven gold (box bought and stored)
options.result: Sven happy. reported 5,000 gold + Courtly Breeches/Tunic.

options.label: Give Sven the box itself
options.result: Sven pleased but less so. reported 4,000 gold + ring/items.

name: The Phantom Oxcart: The smuggler offers you a bribe
prompt: The smuggler offers you a bribe

options.label: Accept gold
options.result: Navil escapes. 5,000 gold.

options.label: Escort to Vermund
options.result: Navil sent to dungeons.

name: Tensions on the Highroad: Whose side do you take?

options.label: Pick Simon
options.result: Chase Raghnall. ambush. talk to Raghnall at campfire.

options.label: Pick Raghnall
options.result: Fight beside him. he ends up trapped in cave.

name: Short-Sighted Ambition: Do you give Isaac the real book?
prompt: Do you give Isaac the real book?

options.label: Give Isaac the book
options.result: He turns wife and daughter to dust. he leaves in denial. Ring of Disfavor.

options.label: Withhold, give fake
options.result: Family spared. 16,000 gold + a volume of the book.

name: A Candle in the Storm: Do you back the Empress's proposal?
prompt: Do you back the Empress's proposal?

options.label: Support the Empress's proposal
options.result: Night bandits. asked to eliminate the Empress.

options.label: Oppose it
options.result: Assassin flees on finding Empress fake. Menella says you failed.

name: Vernworth story: A guard asks where a running urchin went
prompt: A guard asks where a running urchin went

options.label: Tell the truth
options.result: The guard chases the urchin off.

options.label: Lie
options.result: The urchin gets away for now. The guard finds him later and asks you to look again.

name: The Caged Magistrate: Waldhar keeps talking while you free him
prompt: Waldhar keeps talking while you free him

options.label: Urge him to escape
options.result: He won't go until he has his tomes. The Gracious Hand's Vault (opened by The Heel of History) has room for them.

options.label: Tell him to stop talking
options.result: He keeps chatting but still follows the law.

name: Hunt for the Jadeite Orb: Who gets the orb?

options.label: Real orb to Everard
options.result: You get gold and the Ring of Skullduggery.

options.label: Real orb to Offulve
options.result: You get gold and the Elite Camping Kit.

options.label: Buy a forgery from Ibrahim and satisfy both
options.result: You get both items and the most gold overall, but the forgery costs 12,000 gold up front.

advice: Want both rewards? Buy the forgeries from Ibrahim's Scrap Store and hand one to each buyer.

name: Regalia Sword: Who repairs the sword?

options.label: Trust Sara with it
options.result: Sara repairs it using 15 Glimmercoal.

options.label: Refuse
options.result: It gets repaired without Sara.

name: Legacy: The Dragon offers you a way out
prompt: The Dragon offers you a way out

options.label: Flee and accept
options.result: Bad ending: a sad coronation and the credits roll.

options.label: Fight and win
options.result: Good ending: coronation and banquet. Sit on the throne for an achievement.

options.label: Fight, then retry with the Empowered Godsbane Blade
options.result: True ending path: talk to the Pathfinder instead of taking the throne, ride the Dragon to its heart and use the blade. Leads to the Unmoored World.

advice: To keep the true ending open, you need the Empowered Godsbane Blade from A New Godsway.
